name: ko-lab-call-system-v1
description: Real-time audio/video call system using LiveKit Cloud and WebSocket signaling

signaling.registration: Users register via ?userId= query param in WS URL

messages.call_offer: Initiator -> WS server -> Recipient (individual or group broadcast)
messages.call_ended: Either party -> WS server -> Other party
messages.call_missed: Sent when recipient doesn't respond (not yet implemented server-side)

media.token_gen: AccessToken with roomJoin + canPublish + canSubscribe grants

components.CallProvider: React context provider managing call state, WS connection, LiveKit room
components.CallUI: Root UI orchestrator — renders IncomingCallModal, ActiveCallBar, or CallPanel
components.IncomingCallModal: Full-screen modal with Accept Video, Accept Audio, Reject buttons + ringtone
components.CallPanel: Full-screen call UI — audio mode (black screen) or video mode (grid)
components.ActiveCallBar: Minimized top bar shown when call is active but not expanded
components.CallControls: Bottom controls bar for video calls (mute, video toggle, screen share, end)

models.CallParticipant: Links users to calls with join/leave timestamps

steps: API creates LiveKit room via RoomServiceClient.createRoom
API creates CallRoom in DB with status RINGING + participants
API generates LiveKit token for initiator via createLiveKitToken
Room connects to LiveKit Cloud with token
setActiveCall(...) — CallUI auto-expands to full CallPanel
wsSend({ type: 'call_offer', targetId/groupId, callId, roomName, callerName, callType })
WS server looks up recipient in individualClients (by targetId) or broadcasts to group
Ringtone plays via Web Audio API oscillator (440Hz pulsed)
User sees caller name, call type (Audio/Video), Accept Video, Accept Audio, Reject buttons

accept_call.trigger: User clicks Accept Video or Accept Audio
steps: API validates caller is a participant, updates status to ONGOING
API returns LiveKit token for the acceptor
Room({ audioCaptureDefaults: {}, videoCaptureDefaults: {...} }) connects to LiveKit
setActiveCall(...) — CallUI auto-expands to full CallPanel
wsSend({ type: 'call_accepted', initiatorId, ... }) to notify caller
Caller receives call_rejected → toast 'Call rejected', room disconnected, setActiveCall(null)
Other party receives call_ended → room disconnected, setActiveCall(null)

audio_mode_ui.condition: videoEnabled === false (set on Accept Audio or AUDIO call type)
elements: Top bar: 'Audio Call' label + minimize button
Center: Large circular avatar + call type label + participant count
Bottom: 3 large circular buttons — Mute (toggles muted state), Switch to Video (sets videoEnabled=true), End Call (red)
Top bar: 'Video Call' label + minimize button
Main: VideoGrid showing remote participants + local participant
Bottom: CallControls bar — Mute, Video toggle, Screen Share, Participants list, End Call

env_vars.WS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: Comma-separated allowed origins for WS connections

known_limitations: No push notifications for incoming calls when user is offline
No call recording UI (DB model exists but unused)
No call timeout for unanswered RINGING calls
ScreenShareView has a TypeScript type error (ScreenShareView.tsx:17)
